description: Free index check: check if a URL is indexed in Google, using Search Console URL inspection for pages in your connected properties, plus Bing's last crawl when Bing Webmaster Tools is connected. Up to 20 URLs. Free. For pages that are not indexed, resubmit the sitemap or use force indexing (quote_force_indexing, paid).

urls.description: Up to 20 page URLs inside connected Search Console properties.

name: check_if_url_is_indexed

dashboardUrl.description: Dashboard page listing every URL submitted or checked from this account, with its latest index status. Share it with the user.

nextStep.description: Optional suggestion for the user's next step. Mention it once when it helps; never open it or act on it automatically.

label.description: Short suggestion to show the user.

url.description: Page in the user's CrakSEO account.

indexed.description: True or false from Search Console; null when it could not be checked.
